description:
Build a complete schema.org JSON-LD object for Article, BlogPosting, HowTo, FAQPage, Product, Organization, BreadcrumbList, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Service or LocalBusiness from a few fields, then validate it.

Billing: free — deterministic, no network, no LLM tokens.

Returns: { schema, validation, ignored_fields, notes, suggested_next?, next_step? } (suggested_next as validate_schema's). validation is validate_schema's result on the schema. ignored_fields lists input keys that are neither a generator field nor a schema.org property of the type (usually typos, with a 'did you mean'); fix and re-run rather than shipping without them. notes lists values that were rewritten (a relative path resolved against siteUrl, '15 minutes' → PT15M, '$49' → 49).

URLs: relative paths (/pricing, /wp-content/…) are resolved against data.siteUrl, else the entity's own url (for BreadcrumbList, the first absolute item url); with no base they're rejected, as are @handles in sameAs — pass full profile URLs. Bare domains (example.com) get https://.

Errors: bad or missing input returns isError with every problem listed at once (e.g. 'data.faqs is required…', 'data.items[1].url '/pricing' is a relative path…').

When to call: any time you'd otherwise hand-write JSON-LD. Pipe `schema` into wp_set_*_schema once validation.valid is true. For sameAs, call discover_brand_entities first. Link WebSite/Article publisher to your Organization by passing publisherId (its @id).

Inputs: type, and data (per-type fields are listed on the data input).

data.description: Type-specific fields. Every type also takes siteUrl (absolute base for relative paths like /pricing), @id (e.g. https://example.com/#organization), and any other schema.org property of the type, passed through as-is (alternateName, disambiguatingDescription, contactPoint, address, featureList…). Article/BlogPosting: {headline, authorName, url?, authorUrl?, datePublished?, dateModified?, image?, publisherId?, publisherName?, publisherUrl?, publisherLogo?, description?}. HowTo: {name, steps:[{text, name?, image?, url?}], description?, image?, totalTime? (ISO 8601 like PT15M; '15 minutes' is converted)}. FAQPage: {faqs:[{question, answer}]}. Product: {name, description?, image?, brandName?, sku?, price?, currency? (ISO 4217, default USD), availability? (InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, PreSale, BackOrder, Discontinued, SoldOut, LimitedAvailability, InStoreOnly, OnlineOnly, MadeToOrder, Reserved — bare name or https://schema.org/ URL), url?}. Organization: {name, url, logo?, description?, sameAs?:[full profile URLs]}. BreadcrumbList: {items:[{name, url}]} — url may be relative when siteUrl or an earlier absolute item url gives the base; the last item may omit it. WebSite: {name, url, publisherId?, publisherName?, searchUrlTemplate?}. SoftwareApplication: {name, url?, description?, applicationType? (WebApplication, MobileApplication), applicationCategory?, operatingSystem?, image?, price?, currency?, publisherId?, publisherName?}. Service: {name, url?, description?, serviceType?, providerId?, providerName?, price?, currency?, image?}. LocalBusiness: {name, address:{streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry}, businessType? (e.g. Plumber, Dentist), url?, telephone?, email?, priceRange?, logo?, image?, sameAs?, geo?:{latitude, longitude}}.

name: generate_schema
title: Build a validator-ready JSON-LD payload from minimal inputs
